Name: A Little Luck - Nagito (East Scarp Addon)
Author: LavenderLight
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/meet-nagito.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[quote]Nagito is a friendly but socially awkward individual who moved to Pelican Town from the Fern Islands the autumn before the farmer showed up. He's struggled to find his place in town, mostly keeping to himself and hanging out with his dog, Hope. They do feel camaraderie with the farmer also being new. He's also quite superstitious... [/quote]Nagito is a custom NPC who resides in East Scarp on the beach by Rosa's stand. He has 14 (un)lucky events, *two special orders, two quests, twelve new crops, and three new recipes. He is [b]not[/b] romanceable.

Do you recognise Nagito? Do you want to romance him, do not use East Scarp, or want a version of him closer to what he is based on? Check out the legacy 1.6 update of Nagito by Quote Izkewl [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34865]here[/url]!

If you want to have both Nagitos in your game, you can do that too!

*One special order only appears if you have NeoLuna's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33111]CP conversion of FishWaffles64's Lucky Clover mod![/url]

[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/Compatibility.png[/img][/center]
[center]Nagito is compatible with all other East Scarp mods, Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and Sunberry Village. He also has custom gift tastes for certain mods, and compatibility with custom Festivals.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Nagito also features compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Slightly Cuter Sprites[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu style portraits[/url] out of the box.[/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/Nagito_Preview.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/about-nagito.png[/img][/center]
[center][spoiler][b]Birthday:[/b] Spring 28

[b]Loves:[/b] Lucky Lunch, Rabbit's Foot, Diamond, Rainbow Shell, Books
[b]Likes:[/b] Food, Gems, Flowers, Joja Cola, Green Tea, Solar Essence, Deep Sea Glass, Red and Purple Mushrooms
    [b]Neutral:[/b] Honey, Minerals
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Sweet Gem Berry, Alcohol
[b]Hates: [/b]Trash, rice and rice dishes, Skeletal Hand, Butterfly Powder

[b]Where to find him:[/b]
In his house, East Scarp, Pelican Town Library/Museum, or the graveyard in Pelican Town.
He visits the Beach in Summer 
He goes shopping at both Pierre's and JojaMart,alternating each Tuesday.
Nagito will visit Ridgeside Village, and/or Sunberry Village once a month if you have them installed.
(Pika's in RSV on the 6th, D&D's Cat Cafe in SBV on the 18th) 
He has a doctor's appointment at Harvey's clinic on the 3rd of each month.
Nagito is disabled and sometimes has days where he will not leave his house. This is intentional.[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/heart-events.png[/img][/center]
[center][spoiler][b]Main Events[/b]
[b]2 Hearts:[/b] Beach, sunny
[b]4 Hearts:[/b] East Scarp, morning (6:00-11:00am)
  [b]6 Hearts:[/b] Wizard's Tower, night (19:00-24:50/7:00 pm to 12:50am), clear weather
[b]6 1/2 Hearts:[/b] Nagito's house when he's there
[b]8 Hearts:[/b] East Scarp when Nagito is there, sunny, 7:00-18:50/7:00am to 6:50pm)
[b]10 Hearts:[/b] East Scarp, sunny, after receiving letter
[b]
Extra Events[/b]
[b]1 Heart:[/b] East Scarp, clear weather, 9:00-18:00/9:00am-6:00pm)
[b]3 Hearts:[/b] Museum when Nagito is there
[b]5 Hearts:[/b] East Scarp Deep Mountains, clear weather, night (19:00-2:00/9:00pm to 2:00am)
on a bad luck day ("somewhat annoyed" or worse)
[b]7 Hearts:[/b] Bathhouse, 13:00-22:00/1:00pm to 10:00pm
[b]9 Hearts:[/b] East Scarp, clear weather, night (20:00-2350/8:00pm to 11:50pm)
[b]Emily Event:[/b] 2 Hearts with Emily and Nagito, Town, sunny, good luck day ("In good humour" or better), 9:00am to 15:00/3:00pm
[b]Abigail Event:[/b] 2 Hearts with Abigail and Nagito, Pierre's
[b]Morris Event:[/b] JojaMart when Nagito is there, must not have bought JojaMembership[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/permissions.png[/img][/center]
You can:
- Translate Nagito to another language.
- Make new portrait, sprites, and art assets for him.
- Reach out to me about crossovers and compatibility!

You can not:
- Use any asset or line of this mod for anything involving generative AI.
- Reupload anywhere else.

[center][img]https://file.garden/ZUFS5P2dI3BS8SLG/web%20stuff/nexus/nagito/credits.png[/img][/center]
Thank you to LemurKat for East Scarp and the map patches
Quote Izkewl for the legacy update to 1.6, and encouragement
The ES Discord Server for the assistance and support
And a big thank you to everyone who has played with Nagito over the years from his days as an xnb Elliott replacement to now!
